qualification_scope: AMDPilot artifact-delivery workflow qualification for FlyDSL only; not a claim about all repository behavior

native_import.note: flydsl._mlir is a namespace package and therefore has no __file__; loaded wrapper modules and native shared objects are enumerated in environment_probe.raw.txt

commands.numerical_measurement: The repository test computes max(abs(GPU - Torch(a + b))) and asserts it is < 1e-5; it does not print the value.

limitations: Focused qualification only: one existing pointer-argument vector-add unit test and one independent masked-tail/sentinel probe were run.
The existing unit test exposes its 1e-5 assertion threshold but does not print its computed maximum error.
No native sources were changed, so the pinned native compiler was not rebuilt and the environment was not reinstalled.
GPU visibility variables were unset, but Torch reported exactly one visible logical GPU; only logical device 0 was used.
